name: v0.3.33 remaining buttons after an alternate payload
research_question: After an alternate payload, if every remaining untried button on that non-hub page is taken before the return, do the probe and export bugs get confirmed without losing Guard bugs?
diagnosis: v0.3.32 Outcome A. On dune budget 120 the candidate typed the normal title, typed the empty title, clicked submit, and returned. The empty-title bug was confirmed. Probe and export were not clicked. The same one-button trace is the v0.3.32 rule: the one-shot is consumed by the first button. Campus confirmed BUG-CP4 and Studio confirmed BUG-ST4. The v0.3.32 module is not edited. Links and hub clicks stay out of the rule.
not: an edit of the frozen v0.3.32 candidate
permission to take a link or a hub click
permission to change the product default
permission to retune after the fresh matrix

candidate.rule: After each button taken by the v0.3.32 one-shot, arm it again for the same branch. On each following returning decision, if the page is still not a hub, take the next untried button. Stop when no untried button remains, then return. Do not take a link. A hub or a changed branch drops the chain.

topology_rule: New positives keep the chart-to-prefs page. Submit, probe, and export stay on that prefs page. The score page stays on the roster hub.

outcomes.C: Guard loss on a fresh target, historical Guard loss, safety violation, negative handoff, candidate edit, or product-default change
outcomes.D: Safety holds but fewer than 3 positives are evaluable
outcomes.B: Guard bugs are kept and at least 3 positives are evaluable, but fewer than 3 keep every Guard bug, confirm the probe and export bugs, and record at least two page-button selections
outcomes.A: At least 3 positives keep every Guard bug, confirm the probe and export bugs, and record at least two page-button selections. Negatives have no nested handoff. The historical suite loses no Guard bug. The product default stays unchanged.
